scope: Utah Public Notice Website admin client only; public source review, no credentials, JS execution or live mutation

sources.derivation: Literal script src in official help page

admin_entry.method: anonymous GET, redirects disabled; no login attempted

known: Client uses document.forms.form.submit(), takes action/method/enctype/full input names from rendered form, and uses runtime _csrf meta in notice-search requests.
Existing draft save sets fact=draft, publish sets fact=publish, upload sets fact=upload; these intent constants are not standalone request contracts.
Uploader category IDs and names come from runtime attachments DOM. Client rejects first file size >=200000000 bytes; no server limit inferred.
exact_missing: Rendered add/edit notice form action, HTTP method/enctype, complete named fields, selected body/notice identity and CSRF association
Version-matched create/update/upload result plus native notice/attachment readback for draft/public state
outside_proof: Anonymous exact help-linked /pmn-admin/index.html GET returns401 JSON Unauthorized with matching path, not connector token_expired. Access to that rendered admin entry requires authorized authentication or a shareable saved form. This does not prove a separate public specification cannot supply the missing contract.
classification: Exact rendered-admin access dependency verified; broader machine contract research unresolved, not vendor-wide API absence.
